purpose: Ilustraciones temáticas originales, no imágenes documentales de personas o lugares históricos.

prompts.name: estudio-biblico
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide editorial banner for Verbo, a Spanish Christian Bible study website and collection of documented Christian biographies. Create a refined painterly editorial still life: an open well-worn Bible with naturally indistinct tiny page markings, a closed navy clothbound notebook, an understated fountain pen, on a warm cream oak desk beside a softly lit window; subtle bookshelf silhouettes in background. Landscape 3:2 composition, main Bible in lower center, atmospheric breathing room above; rich matte brush texture, realistic objects but clearly an artistic illustration rather than photography. Palette strictly warm ivory #FBF1DE, cream #FFFBF2, deep navy #0B2A56, muted blue #4C6B99, restrained golden ochre #C8862E. Quiet, dignified, welcoming, premium editorial illustration, natural warm light, moderate contrast. No people, no faces, no logos, no legible letters or text, no watermarks, no church denominational symbols, no ornamental borders. This is illustrative atmosphere, not a historical artifact reproduction.

prompts.name: palabra-impresa
prompts.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: original editorial illustration for a documented Christian biography collection about Bible translators and authors. Create a beautifully composed 3:2 landscape painterly illustration of an early modern European printing workshop: a sturdy dark wooden hand printing press on left, carefully laid loose cream sheets with nonlegible markings, an open bound book on a worktable, type trays suggested subtly, warm window light and a navy shadowed wall. No people. It must be a thematic illustration, not a reproduction of any real historical photograph or a claim to depict a particular historical person's workspace. Fine matte oil and gouache textures, refined and calm premium book-cover art, realistic coherent mechanical form. Palette warm ivory #FBF1DE, cream #FFFBF2, deep navy #0B2A56, muted blue #4C6B99, restrained ochre #C8862E. Keep important objects central and within middle 80% for responsive crops. No legible text, no logos, no watermark, no decorative border, no luminous supernatural elements.

prompts.name: puertas-abiertas

Subtle blue-gray outer shadows and warm interior; inviting, sober, hopeful, no drama. Composition important objects in center 80%, room seen from threshold, genuine simple objects and coherent perspective. Matte oil and gouache texture, clearly illustration rather than documentary photograph. Palette warm ivory #FBF1DE, cream #FFFBF2, deep navy #0B2A56, muted blue #4C6B99 and restrained ochre #C8862E. No people, no portraits, no faces, no names, no text, no logo, no watermark, no decorative borders. Do not depict an identifiable real historical building, Holocaust scene, or specific person's room. This is symbolic hospitality art only.
